name: interview-debriefer
description: Turns one interview into structured notes within 24 hours, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run interview-debriefer", "debrief this interview", "structure my interview notes", "here's the transcript from today's call", or an interview just ended and the notes are a wall of raw text. Use it even for "I just got off a user call".
